newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet postpones meeting at govt request.
newsitem.headline: Eramet postpones meeting at govt request.

text.p: French mining group Eramet said on Monday its decision to postpone a board meeting called for June 24 was at the request of the new Socialist government and was meant to give more time to review issues linked to a row over mining rights in New Caledonia.

In a statement issued earlier Eramet said a board meeting scheduled for June 24 had been postponed to the second week of July. The group also said the annual general meeting would take place around the end of July.

"The government asked us to postpone the board meeting to give itself more time to study the issue and we agreed. The new team in charge wants to review the whole affair. We think this is positive," a company spokesman told Reuters.
